title: Notice regarding re-arrangement of taking up the matters of Hon'ble the First Court and non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Nikhil S. Kariel on 06.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
1. Read :- Notice No. HCG-02/2026, dated 05/10/2026.
Date: - 06/10/2026
Preamble, It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
1. Read :- Notice No. HCG-02/2026, dated 05/10/2026.
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 06/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
In modification of the Notice mentioned in the
Preamble, It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nikhil S. Kariel would not be available for
Judicial as well as Administrative work.
(2) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Manash Ranjan Pathak would sit
Single and take up the matters at Sr. No. 382 to Sr. No.
406 notified before Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr.
Justice Aniruddha P. Mayee.)
(3) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K.
Vishen and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble the First Court.
(4) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K.
Vishen and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Manash Ranjan
Pathak and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nikhil S. Kariel.)
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
